> **Supplementary Figure 4.** Re-deriving each source database's surface-inclusion rule against SurfaceBench changes which proteins two of the five sources admit, while three are already well-calibrated. Each panel shows one source database; points are alternative inclusion rules of increasing permissiveness, plotted by the number of proteins each would admit (horizontal axis, log scale; further left is stricter) against classification accuracy on SurfaceBench, the 147-protein benchmark of manually labeled surface, contextually surface, and non-surface proteins (vertical axis). Each point is annotated with the fraction of true surface proteins recovered and the fraction of non-surface proteins correctly excluded. The current rule and the rule recommended after the benchmark audit are marked. UniProt was loosened by additionally accepting transmembrane- and signal-peptide-annotated entries, recovering GPI-anchored and single-pass receptors it had been missing with little loss of specificity. CSPA was tightened by restricting it to high-confidence detections only, improving specificity at comparable recall. Human Protein Atlas, and SURFY rules were already at their accuracy optimum and were left unchanged, while GO’s gain in accuracy wasn’t justified based on the number of additional proteins added. [Figure data and script.](https://gist.github.com/beccajcarlson/f9319af882e372194bd30640c0cbf2ed) #####
<!-- END manuscript-legend -->

For each of the 5 M1 surface DBs (UniProt, GO CC, HPA, SURFY, CSPA),
a small panel plotting how the choice of "surface-vote" cutoff
trades universe size (proteins this filter admits, log-scale x) for
benchmark accuracy on the 147-gene bench (y, %). Lower-x = stricter.

Markers:
* Circle — alternative cutoff option, not currently used in the
  M1 merge rules.
* Diamond — canonical baseline currently configured in the loaders
  (cross-checked against `candidate_universe.tsv` flag counts).
* Star — recommended cutoff after the trade-off audit, shown only
  when it differs from canonical (currently: UniProt "TM+signal"
  and CSPA "HC-only").

Per-point annotation: variant short label, universe size,
`+pos% / -neg%` recall on the bench.

Run:

```
uv run make_db_cutoff_tradeoff.py
```

  Dumped by the canonical generator when it runs, so re-running
